asset.name: UnsavedChangesFlow
asset.description: The protection workflow intercepting navigation or dismissal and offering save, discard, continue editing, or background preservation of the work in progress.

requires.reason: Meaningful-change detection and interception are shared.
The decision is presented through the shared confirmation surface.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Background preservation is what elevates this above a confirm dialog: the best answer to leaving with unsaved work is usually to keep it safely rather than to make the user choose between saving and losing it.
